title: Reconciliation BFS traverses entire local DAG with unbounded cost
description: core/group_log/reconcile.rs:34-80: reconcile() BFS-traverses all local entries reachable from tips to compute the 'have' set, building a HashSet<LogEntryId> across the entire local DAG. Output is capped at MAX_HAVE=1000 but traversal cost is unbounded. For a group with millions of entries, repeated reconciliations over a slow connection stress both memory (HashSet allocation) and CPU. Fix: limit BFS depth (not just output length) and return is_truncated so callers know to re-reconcile.
